visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A vibrant close-up shot introduces a large burger resting on a wooden serving board. The burger features stacked layers of grilled meat patties, a fried egg with crispy edges, shredded cabbage, and fresh cucumber slices under a sesame-seeded bun. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with blurred patrons in the background. Yellow variety-show text overlays appear at the top. (2) A male character with short black hair, wearing a white crew-neck t-shirt, appears in a medium shot at a red dining table. He uses a serrated steel knife to meticulously slice the burger in half. His facial expression is one of focused concentration and excitement. The indoor restaurant environment is visible with wooden accents and wall menus. (3) The character pulls the two burger halves apart toward the camera, emphasizing the thick filling and multiple layers. He smiles broadly, showing his teeth, while looking directly into the lens. Orange and white graphic text highlighting the richness of the ingredients pops up. The lighting is warm and natural. (4) The male takes a large bite of a sandwich, closing his eyes in satisfaction. He then displays another sandwich, pointing out the tuna and vegetable layers inside. He is seen sitting in the same indoor restaurant setting. Textual overlays provide the dish names and prices in New Taiwan Dollars. (5) Transition to the kitchen area where a pair of hands is shown cutting freshly cooked green onion pancakes on a white cutting board. The character is then shown back at the table eating the pancakes with wooden chopsticks. He laughs heartily, tilting his head back, with humorous text floating nearby. (6) A scene shift shows the character outdoors leaning against a white brick wall in an urban alley with parked cars. He looks physically exhausted, drooping his shoulders and looking downward. Then, he is shown sitting on a grey indoor sofa with a laptop, holding his head in a stressed manner. (7) A high-definition close-up shows a golden kiwi being sliced neatly in half on a wooden board. Hands use a spoon to scoop out a perfect, translucent slice of the fruit. The lighting is bright and crisp, highlighting the juicy texture and seeds of the kiwi. (8) Colorful informational graphics occupy the screen, featuring a map of Taiwan with various breakfast icons and prize lists. The Zespri brand logo is clearly visible alongside cartoon kiwi characters. The background is a pale green with festive, promotional design elements. (9) The male character is shown back on the sofa, looking energized and happy while eating the kiwi with a spoon. He talks animatedly to the camera, gesturing with his hands. He wears a clean white t-shirt and the background is a neutral living room setting. The final frame features large slogan text across the screen.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a bustling traditional breakfast shop with red tables and wooden wall menus, an outdoor city alley with a white wall and parked vehicles, and a cozy modern living room with a grey sofa and a laptop on a low table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4-on-the-floor beat opens the video. A male voice enters immediately with high arousal and a bright, friendly tone, speaking rapidly in Mandarin. A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the arrival of text on screen. (2) The BGM continues with a percussive synth texture. A crisp, rasping sound of a knife cutting through crusty bread is clearly heard, layered over the voice. A comedic 'pop' sound effect marks a transition between different burger shots. (3) Loud 'crunch' sound effects indicate the character biting into food, followed by muffled chewing sounds. The speaker's pitch rises during exclamations of surprise. A 'whoosh' transition sound effects the shift to a new food item. (4) Background music ducks slightly to emphasize the character's vocal articulation. Low-level ambient room tone of a restaurant is barely audible. A short 'sparkle' SFX plays during a close-up of the tuna ingredients. (5) Sound of chopsticks clicking and a paper cup being set on a hard surface. The male speaker lets out a loud, high-pitched laugh that blends into the upbeat music track. Sound effects are frequent and varied. (6) The BGM shifts to a slightly more subdued, rhythmic beat as the voice tone drops in arousal to mimic tiredness. A soft 'sigh' is audible. The music remains major-mode but less aggressive in its percussion. (7) A bright, major-key 'magic chime' SFX triggers a shift to a new, even more upbeat jingle. The sound of a spoon clinking against a kiwi fruit and scooping through juicy flesh is prominent and clear. (8) Fast-paced narration resumes with high vocal energy. Each prize on the graphic list is accompanied by a 'ding' or 'pop' sound effect. The BGM remains loud and promotional in quality. (9) Final sequence features a mix of satisfied vocalizations ('Ah!', 'Mmm!') and the sound of the spoon hitting the kiwi. The BGM reaches a crescendo with high spectral brightness before ending with a final hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Review -> Conflict -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video starts as a traditional Taiwanese breakfast shop review to build trust and appetite. It then pivots to a 'conflict'—feeling fatigued after breakfast—to introduce Zespri Kiwis as the nutritional solution. The final half is a dedicated promotion for a Zespri giveaway campaign.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The second half of the video is entirely dedicated to the nutritional benefits of Zespri Kiwis and a specific giveaway campaign with a branded prize list.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly professional social-media edit that effectively transitions from organic content to a paid endorsement using high-arousal narration and dynamic sound design.
